message.content:
The **best AI visibility tracking tools** depend on whether you want *enterprise analytics, affordable tracking, SEO integration, or workflow/actionability*. Across recent reviews, the most consistently recommended options are **Profound**, **Otterly.AI**, **Peec AI**, **SE Visible / SE Ranking**, **Ahrefs Brand Radar**, **Semrush**, **Surfer AI Tracker**, and **Amplitude AI Visibility**.[1][2][3][5][6][17][19][20]

Here’s the clearest way to choose:

| Tool | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Profound** | Enterprise teams | Frequently listed as the top enterprise-grade option and strong for large-scale monitoring.[1][5][6][17] |
| **Otterly.AI** | Budget-conscious teams | Repeatedly highlighted for affordability and simple tracking.[1][6][9][12][17] |
| **Peec AI** | Prompt tracking and brand reputation | Often recommended for smart suggestions, multi-engine monitoring, and daily prompt workflows.[1][6][9][17] |
| **SE Visible / SE Ranking** | Balanced SEO + AI visibility | Strong when you want AI visibility inside a broader SEO suite.[3][5][12][20] |
| **Ahrefs Brand Radar** | Benchmarking and competitor analysis | Good for teams already using Ahrefs and wanting brand-level AI tracking.[5][6][19] |
| **Semrush AI Toolkit** | Existing Semrush users | Best when you want AI visibility combined with SEO and content workflows.[1][20] |
| **Surfer AI Tracker** | Content optimization + visibility | Recommended for teams that want both tracking and actions to improve visibility.[19] |
| **Amplitude AI Visibility** | Business outcome tracking | Useful when you want to connect AI mentions to traffic, usage, or revenue.[6][10][16][19] |

A practical shortlist by use case:

- **Best overall enterprise choice:** **Profound**.[1][5][6][17]
- **Best low-cost option:** **Otterly.AI**.[1][6][9][12][17]
- **Best for actionable insights:** **Peec AI** or **Frase**.[1][2][6][17]
- **Best all-in-one SEO + AI visibility:** **Semrush** or **SE Ranking / SE Visible**.[3][5][20]
- **Best for competitor benchmarking:** **Ahrefs Brand Radar**.[5][6][19]
- **Best for content teams:** **Surfer AI Tracker** or **Frase**.[2][19]
- **Best for tying visibility to revenue:** **Amplitude AI Visibility**.[6][10][16]

If you want the simplest recommendation:

- Choose **Profound** if you’re enterprise or need the deepest reporting.[1][5][6]
- Choose **Otterly.AI** if you want an affordable starter tool.[1][6][9]
- Choose **Peec AI** if you want the best mix of tracking and practical recommendations.[1][6][17]
- Choose **Semrush** or **Ahrefs** if you already use those SEO platforms.[1][5][20]

If you want, I can also give you a **top 5 ranked list by budget**, **by team size**, or **by exact feature set**.
